description: The plot illustrates the average repetition rate across different relation categories for three distinct models, comparing their performance. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category," has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 60 with a tick label interval of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Average Repetition Rate," also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 0.6 with a tick label interval of 0.1. The blue line, representing "w/o DPO obo," starts at approximately 0.58 and ends at around 0.17, with notable peaks at relation categories 2 and 37, reaching values of about 0.6 and 0.63, respectively. The orange line, denoting "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," begins at roughly 0.29 and concludes at approximately 0.17, displaying fluctuations throughout. The green line, signifying "DPO," commences at around 0.12 and terminates at about 0.17, generally maintaining lower values than the other two lines. Additionally, the plot includes dashed lines representing the average repetition rates for each model, with values of 0.163 for "w/o DPO obo," 0.227 for "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," and 0.117 for "DPO."
